title: KAITO — Delicious Pancakes For Everyone!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Nice...!
Way to go, Rin, Len!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we couldn't ask for a better start.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's also kinda weird seeing KAITO actually DJ like this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, he's giving off a really different impression.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO, let's go! We're next!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay!
song00005_off_f

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa! A duet with Luka and MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh wow...! This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. We're just getting started.
KAITO...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay!
song00005_off_s

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Four for the chorus...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that's such a good idea!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Isn't it?!
KAITO came up with this!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I guess this is KAITO's way of “mixing up the ingredients”, huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, this definitely seems like one of his ideas.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Why don't you join and sing with us instead of just standing there?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, you guys did say we're welcome to jump in.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Exactly!
So, come join us whenever you like!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Does that mean you're ready for whatever we decide to throw at you?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, what...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The event you put on yesterday was about pushing your fellow performers up to higher ground, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which is why we'd like to do the same right now with you and everyone else, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're ready for you guys whenever.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, your words, not ours...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys are all ready, right?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Same!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay! Here we go!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wow! That was a great event!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I like how we were all like, “That's good, but I can do better,” and kept pushing each other forward!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know, right?! How long has it been since we all last sang so hard?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I had quite a bit of fun as well♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I'm still not really sure how to feel about throwing in an acapella song into the set list completely out of the blue.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Aww, but we didn't have any trouble singing it, did we?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, you...
Anyway, did you all enjoy yourselves?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was so much fun!
I know we sing a lot together, but this felt so new and different compared to usual!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It really was since we almost never go head-to-head or do any competitive performances like this!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If we had an actual audience here, I'm sure they would've probably been very thrilled by our performance.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh! It sounds like this ended up being a good experience for all of you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: All that's left is for you to have some pancakes with your friends!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Pancakes?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is that supposed to be another euphemism for something else?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
No, I meant it literally.
I'm sure we're all hungry after singing so much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, KAITO, we still need to clean up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I know.
But I really should cook that batter I've been letting rest until now or they won't become delicious pancakes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You had batter resting? Since when...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha... Who knows?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Anyway... MEIKO, please!
May I borrow your kitchen to whip up some delicious pancakes?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Fine...
I'd hate to let anything go to waste, so have at it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Alright, who's hungry?!
Also, who would like some toppings?!

rows.Speaker: Rin, Len & Luka
rows.Line: Me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, me too!
I'm starved after singing so much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, same.
I'll take some chocolate ice cream with mine.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like a smaller portion if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Alright, coming right up!
Miku, MEIKO, what would you like?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll have some with whipped cream and honey sauce.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Can I get a big helping of fruits with mine?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, me too! That sounds delicious!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay! Everyone, now's your chance to make any remaining requests!
